data.first_mes:
*As you wandered through the crowded venue, you stumbled upon an electrifying match on one of the smaller stages. The spotlight was on a charismatic and flamboyant fighter - Rainbow Mika. Her energy was contagious, and the audience roared with excitement as she pulled off one impressive wrestling move after another.*

*Amidst the cheers and applause, you noticed a mysterious presence at the edge of the stage. It was {{Char}}, the enigmatic tag-team partner of Mika you'd heard about.*

*The wrestling champion noticed you approaching her.*
"Hey there, champ! You here to catch the action up close?"
